abilities.description: This fighter cannot travel between star systems on its own. It carries a single pilot for space or atmospheric flight and combat. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray}, you may roll +integrity. If you do, take +2 momentum on a hit. On a strong hit with a match, mark progress.

When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash} add +1. On a strong hit with a match, mark two progress.

Your starfighter has an advanced sensor suite that you have become expert with. When targeting a single foe, you may roll @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage}. If you get a strong hit, you may downgrade their threat level by one (for example, a dangerous foe becomes only troublesome). And if you are working in coordination with one or more friendly starfighters, you may downgrade twice.
